tool.name: datav-generate-screen
tool.description:
Generate (create) a draft big screen with free-canvas widgets from a structured specification.
Workflow: First call datav-list-component-types to discover available component types, then use datav-list-datasets / datav-describe-dataset / datav-query-dataset to understand the available data, then call this tool ONCE to author the screen.
Creates: - A Screen row with publishStatus=DRAFT (version=0, not published). - One ScreenWidget per widgets[] entry (componentType stored as string directly; datasetRefId stores the nop-report dataset sid directly as a logical reference — no DatasetRef row is created; widgetConfig.fieldMapping stores the provided fieldMapping; x/y/w/h/z store the free-canvas position).
Validation (failures return explicit errors, the loop will feed them back so you can correct and retry): - componentType MUST be a registered type (all 14 types allowed for screens, including decorative/media). Unknown types return ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT. - For needsDataset=true components (chart/table/stat-tile/pivot-table/map), datasetSid is REQUIRED and must reference an existing active (status=1) dataset that is also visible to the current user (created by the current user, or the caller is admin). A non-existent/inactive dataset returns ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_DATASET_NOT_FOUND; an existing active dataset that is NOT visible to the current user returns ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_DATASET_NO_ACCESS. - For needsDataset=false components, datasetSid is IGNORED (not stored). - Widget position validation: - x/y must be >= 0 and w/h must be > 0, otherwise ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_INVALID_WIDGET_POSITION. - x+w must be <= screenWidth and y+h must be <= screenHeight (MUST NOT exceed canvas bounds), otherwise ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_WIDGET_OUT_OF_BOUNDS. - Widget overlap is ALLOWED (decorative layering) — not validated. - If fieldMapping is provided (with a datasetSid), every referenced field name MUST exist in the dataset's dsMeta field set; otherwise ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_INVALID_SPEC. - If backgroundConfig is provided, it must be parseable as a screen theme (palette/background structure); otherwise ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_INVALID_BACKGROUND_CONFIG. - screenName must be unique; duplicate returns ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_DUPLICATE_SCREEN_NAME.
The generated screen is a DRAFT — the user must explicitly publish it via the platform publishScreen action. You MUST NOT claim the screen is published.
Returns JSON with: - screenId: the created screen ID - widgets: summary of created widgets (widgetName, componentType, datasetRefId, x, y, w, h, z)
Safety constraints (MUST FOLLOW): - You can ONLY reference pre-registered datasets and map existing fields. You MUST NOT generate, write, or execute raw SQL. - The result is a DRAFT. Do NOT auto-publish. - Widgets MUST NOT exceed canvas bounds.
